mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was most worthwhile because the described sequence connects sensation, control and muscle work to a familiar task.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the surface cells was a fairly predictable first step, though the continued water loss gave it a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The skin's surface was still losing water after its cells were joined; the outer layer reduced that loss without stopping it completely.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The item descriptions and goals gave the combinations a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter offered a similarly concrete task. The glass scene made the systems' relationships more interesting than assembling layers alone.
